history.name: The record as one portable document
history.description: The whole record — product, timeline, areas, sub-sections, product-wide changes and every feature with its full history — can be written out as a single structured document, to print, to keep as a backup, or to hand to something that isn't this tool.
history.dev_notes: cmdExport, versioned with schema_version: 1; --out writes to a file, otherwise it goes to standard output.
